drafting: {name} has no step list, so the Copilot is drafting a workflow from it. Review it before you save.
missingBody: The skill {skillId} does not exist or was removed.
failedTitle: Could not open this skill as a workflow
problemsTitle: This playbook cannot be opened as a workflow
problemsBody: Fix these problems in its references/flow.yaml, then open it again.
tooManyBody: It calls more than {limit} playbooks. Reduce the playbooks it calls, then open it again.
bannerBody: This workflow follows the playbook {skillId} and is read-only: it is recompiled whenever the playbook changes. Detach it to edit a copy that no longer follows the playbook.
readOnlySave: This workflow is read-only. Detach it to save changes.
sourceUnavailable: The playbook this workflow follows ({skillId}) can no longer be compiled, so this is the last compiled copy. It cannot run until the playbook is fixed.
notRunnable: This workflow cannot run: the playbook it follows ({skillId}) can no longer be compiled.
dormantNotRunnable: This workflow cannot run yet: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} of its playbook are not runnable in this version.
